written.description: Gives an agent a browser that controls its own network traffic, so the model can capture, edit, replay and compare the requests a web app sends without a proxy in between. Each session runs under a network policy and records every fetch it allowed or refused.

alive.last_commit_message:
h5i app: say when a project's Lean library predates this h5i, and fix… (#821)

* h5i app: say when a project's Lean library predates this h5i, and fix the pin

`check` builds `H5iAppLib.Obligation` (added in v0.5.4). A project that
pins `h5i_app_lib` at an earlier release (the ports in h5i-app-bench pin
v0.5.0) failed only after the whole Lean build, inside Lake, with
"no such file ... Obligation.lean", and `doctor` reported nothing.

- lib_pin.rs: read the pin (lakefile.lean `require h5i_app_lib … @ "<rev>"`,
  lake-manifest.json) and the library on disk; list the modules this h5i
  builds that the pinned library lacks.
- doctor: a `h5i_app_lib` line (ok / not fetched / FAIL with the pin, the
  missing module, the release that added it, and the fix).
- doctor --fix: pin the library at this h5i's release (`new::default_rev`),
  then `lake update h5i_app_lib` in the packages `check` uses (relinked
  and locked first, as `check` does). Aeneas, Mathlib and the rest are
  unchanged; the library is outside the shared packages' key, so nothing
  else is fetched.
- check: the same diagnosis before the Lean build, so it stops at once.

Tried on h5i-app-bench's M5AirQ port (pinned v0.5.0): doctor names the
problem, check stops in 0.3 s instead of failing after 1712 Lean jobs,
doctor --fix moves the pin to v0.5.6 and the following check passes
(proofs ok; panic-free obligation proven by the automation).

* docs: regenerate the manual page for doctor --fix and date it

* docs: regenerate the man page for doctor --fix
